title: Audio Edition
summary: Adapt written content into an approved short episode with narration, a music sting and an optional agent-side audiogram.
outcome: A human-approved, non-truncated MP3 that matches a broadcast script, plus an optional locally assembled audiogram.
boundary: The Skill does not host or publish a podcast feed, bypass paywalls, choose unapproved content, or spend on audio before script approval.

catalog_tools.purpose: Retrieve or enrich a public source when the host cannot fetch it directly.
Generate the approved single-narrator Eleven v3 audio.

inputs: Pasted written content or one public post, newsletter or RSS-item URL
Pronunciation guidance for names or specialist terms
outputs: Narrated MP3 with a short instrumental sting
Optional agent-side audiogram and caption text

cost.model: Inspected research, narration-character and music-generation prices; local scripting and assembly are free.
cost.notes: Trial-safe mode limits narration to 4,000 characters, one optional source search and one three-second sting. The exact current inspected plan must remain at or below the stated maximum.

approvals: Approve the final script, exact narration chunks, voice, sting prompt and maximum cost before the first audio run
Approve any expansion beyond the trial-safe limits
compatibility: One authorized Scrollport connection with apps, discover, inspect, run and wallet
Local audio concatenation for multi-chunk episodes or an audiogram
